# S-015 -- Wall carousel / swipe between walls

This story covers the interaction on Home that lets the user move between wall
cards in the Your Walls carousel and then open the active wall. It builds on the
Home screen (S-014).

## AC

- [ ] The user can swipe, or use a left/right affordance, to move between wall
  cards on Home.
- [ ] The active wall is clearly indicated.
- [ ] Opening the active wall navigates to the Family grid (S-016).
- [ ] The screen ships first as a skeleton with working navigation, then design
  fidelity follows in a later pass.
- [ ] The interaction renders and behaves identically on the web export and on
  an iOS/Android device or simulator from the single Expo/React Native codebase.
